title: Multi-Family LPC Contours and Surface Maintenance Throttle
changes: Composed exact LPC transition families per 16x16 quadrant so one cell can preserve shoreline, depth-rim, and inner-corner roles together.
Included diagonal land contacts in the first shallow-water boundary ring to complete single-cell grass and sand island corners.
Replaced the axis-aligned lake dilation profile with one rotated signed-distance contour for deep, shallow, and mud-bank bands.
Throttled generated-surface maintenance to four checks per second and reconciled hydrology only when stable residency changes.
Added Pass 167Z30 retained-surface telemetry for active state, rebuild count, and draw count.
